content.text: Fluid-filled sac w.in the ovaries MC related to ovulation (USU unilat)
most spontaneously resolve w.in a few wks
occur when follicles fail to rupture & cont to grow
•Does ⍉become clinically sig until it = lrg enough to cause pain or persists beyond one menstrual cycle
excess beta-hCG → hyperplasia of theca interna cells (rare)
: unilat pelvic pain or tenderness, mobile palpable cystic adnexal mass
•most cysts <8cm are funct & USU spontaneously resolve
•OCPs may prevent recurr but don’t tx existing ones
: laparoscopy or laparotomy if lrg or CA-125 = ↑
*cysts in postmenopausal women are considered to be malig until proven otherwise
ASx or sudden onset of unilat lower abd pain often sharp & focal, often occurring during sexual activity or strenuous physical activity
•may have signs of hemodynamic compromise if massive bleed (uncommon)
*Uncomp means absence of hemodynamic instability, lrg vol or ongoing blood loss, fever, leukocytosis, or sus of malig
preferred over oophorectomy in premenopausal women
